All data here is made up (tenants "EX ...", devices "EX-...", IPs 192.0.2.x and 198.51.100.x, MACs 00:00:5e:00:53:xx). `{HOST}` in a `links.next` value is replaced by the test mock. `expected-inventory-main.json` is the exact server response for site 1001 and is also read by the front-end tests.

Attribute and relationship names were pinned against Auvik's public OpenAPI spec on 2026-11-18 (see the Auvik facts in the project notes): tenants carry `domainPrefix`, `tenantType` and `relationships.parent`; display names come from `/tenants/detail?tenantDomainPrefix=` (`displayName`); device info has no MAC (MACs come from device detail `relationships.interfaces`, joined through `relationships.deviceDetail`); `discoveryStatus` is an object; components link through `relationships.parentDevice` and their `detail` is `currentStatus`.

Cables (names pinned 2026-11-19 against the same public spec): `interface-info-main-p1.json` and `-p2.json` are the paged `/inventory/interface/info` answer for tenant 1001 (`interfaceName`, `interfaceType`, `relationships.parentDevice`, `relationships.connectedTo`). Interface ids are `ix-NNN`; `parentDevice` ids are the inventory device ids (`d-1001-NN`). They hold a cable listed on both sides (EX-SW01 1/1/1 and EX-FW01 X1), a two-member LAG with its two aggregates (EX-SW01 and EX-SW02, 1/1/47 and 1/1/48), a one-sided `inferredWired` cable (EX-PRN01 eth0 to EX-SW01 1/1/5), a `wifi` pair and a `vlan` pair (dropped), and a connection to an interface id that is not in the list (dropped). `device-detail-main.json` also has `relationships.connectedDevices` on some devices (device to device, no ports): EX-SRV02 and EX-NAS01 are connected only that way (a port-less row), and one entry names a device that is not in the site (ignored). `expected-links-main.json` is the exact server response for site 1001 and is also read by the front-end tests; `expected-inventory-main.json` is unchanged.
